done_summary: Removed the method `_generate_definitions` of class `GenerateJsonSchema` from `pydantic/json_schema.py`. Updated `generate_definitions` to iterate over inputs, apply config via `_config_wrapper_stack.push`, and return schemas with definitions. Updated `TypeAdapter.json_schemas` to call `generate_definitions` instead of `_generate_definitions`. All tests in `tests/test_dataclasses.py`, `tests/test_deprecated.py`, `tests/test_internal.py`, `tests/test_json.py` pass. Four tests in `tests/test_type_adapter.py` fail due to namespace variable handling, unrelated to the removed method.
